column1: # SPEC-SPELL-120-308 WP-14: sword form - the five eo + siot glyphs share the handler sword.form (SPELL-BUFF sword column). Replaces the reserved rows of Rules308_Base.
# TEST starting values (Q7: build now with defaults). BasePower = power of one strike (x brush). reach 2.6 m / arc = half angle 50 deg / one strike per 0.6 s / upkeep 0.04 ink per second.

# groggy: every 3rd counter strike on the same enemy adds 1 groggy step. release.manual=1: the player may put the sword away. draw.lock = the cost multiplier that refuses every spell while the form lasts (0 = off).
